name: Plaid

tiers.how: Sage reads bank transactions and balances via the Plaid API using `assistant/scripts/money/plaid.py`. The owner must complete the Plaid Link flow once per financial institution to obtain an access token, which is stored in the OS credential store via setup_creds. Token refresh is automatic. This path is strictly read-only; the money lane never initiates payments or transfers.
writes: nothing; Plaid is read-only in this integration
always_tap: re-linking a bank account (owner completes the Plaid Link UI themselves; Sage does not drive it)

gotchas: Plaid access tokens expire or require re-authentication when the bank changes its login flow; monitor for ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED errors and prompt the owner to re-link.
Plaid's free development tier limits the number of supported institutions; upgrade to a paid plan for production use.
Sage never initiates transfers, payments, or any write operation to a financial institution through Plaid.
Plaid Link must be completed by the owner in a browser; Sage cannot drive this UI flow.
notes: Plaid is a read-only bank feed used for cash-flow visibility; Sage reads transaction history and balances but never initiates any financial action.
